# External references

The PDFs in this directory are **third-party material** that informed the
design of IJM. They are kept here for context and are **not** part of this
project's deliverable. Refer to the original sources for licensing terms.

| File | Source | Why it's here |
|---|---|---|
| `ANDREAS D1 - 1st release of the integrated scheduler-Final.pdf` | ANDREAS project (Polimi) — Deliverable D1 | IJM is modelled after ANDREAS' job-scheduling design; D1 documents its initial integrated scheduler. |
| `D2.pdf`, `D3.pdf` | ANDREAS project (Polimi) — Deliverables D2 and D3 | Follow-up ANDREAS deliverables describing later iterations of the scheduler. |
| `A_Path_Relinking_Method_…_with_appendix.pdf` | Filippini et al., *A Path-Relinking Method for the Joint Online Scheduling and Capacity Allocation of DL Training Workloads in GPU-as-a-Service Systems* | The optimization paper behind the GPUspb optimizer integrated via `OPTIMIZER_URL`. |
| `ServerUsageNotes.pdf` | Polimi DEIB — internal server usage notes | Reference for working on the matemagician / polimi-gpu nodes (driver versions, rootless Docker, etc.). |
